geometry.note: 'verified' because representation is 'surveyed' from a rank <=10 official source (KM3NeT-Fr site page, rank 1), corroborated by an independent rank-4 design report (the Letter of Intent) giving the same figure, which itself also states ORCA sits 'approximately 10 kilometers west of the existing ANTARES telescope site'.
